target.rawSql: SELECT detected_at AS time, 'release ' || dist_tag || ' -> v' || version AS text, 'release' AS tags FROM releases WHERE dist_tag IN ('testnet','latest','mainnet','next') AND $__timeFilter(detected_at) ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_stamp AS "time", node_name || ' · ' || source AS metric, CASE WHEN state = 'healthy' THEN 0 WHEN state IN ('elevated','warning','warn') THEN 1 WHEN state IN ('degraded','critical','overloaded') THEN 2 WHEN state IN ('unreachable','no-backpressure-field') THEN 4 ELSE 3 END AS value FROM queue_snapshots WHERE source IN ('store','sync-global','status') AND $__timeFilter(time_stamp) ORDER BY 1
SELECT time_stamp AS "time", node_name AS metric, inflight AS value FROM queue_snapshots WHERE source = 'admission' AND inflight IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time_stamp) ORDER BY 1

SELECT time_stamp AS "time", node_name AS metric, (raw->>'rejectedTotal')::bigint AS value FROM queue_snapshots WHERE source = 'admission' AND raw ? 'rejectedTotal' AND $__timeFilter(time_stamp) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Oldest queued age per lane (ms) — needs node diagnostics token
panels.description: Populates once the recorder has a node-admin token per node (Jenkins credentials). Empty = no lane-level data yet, not necessarily healthy queues.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_stamp AS "time", node_name || ' · ' || source || '/' || COALESCE(lane, '-') AS metric, oldest_age_ms AS value FROM queue_snapshots WHERE oldest_age_ms IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time_stamp) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Queued work per lane — needs node diagnostics token

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_stamp AS "time", node_name || ' · ' || source || '/' || COALESCE(lane, '-') AS metric, queued AS value FROM queue_snapshots WHERE queued IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(time_stamp) ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT ON (node_name) node_name AS "node", node_version AS "version", state, time_stamp AS "last seen" FROM queue_snapshots WHERE source = 'status' ORDER BY node_name, time_stamp DESC
